title: Sticky Feature Flag Rollouts
hints: Evaluate the gates in a fixed order and stop at the first one that decides: kill switch, tenant gate, allowlist, rules, rollout.
The bucket must be the same on every machine and every run. Python's hash() is salted per process; use stable_hash from gc_runtime.
Hash the flag key together with the tenant and user, so different flags pick different users. Then on means bucket < rollout_bp, strictly.
